description: Dense reference evolution under the linear interpolation H(s) = (1-s) H_initial + s H_target. The target Hamiltonian is the terms argument; the default driver is a transverse field -sum_i X_i.
applicable_hamiltonians: Small target Hamiltonians for schedule-discretization studies
Legacy lists of Hermitian dense matrix terms
limitations: Only a linear schedule and dense unitary output are implemented
The default transverse-field driver is a generic reference choice, not a problem-specific preparation protocol
This does not model open-system effects, hardware controls, minimum-gap estimation, or measurement/readout

steps.description: Number of midpoint piecewise-constant schedule intervals.

initial_hamiltonian.description: Optional driver Hamiltonian with the same dimension as the target. Defaults to -sum_i X_i.

schedule.description: Annealing schedule. Only linear is currently supported.

execution.returns: EvolutionResult containing a dense unitary, schedule details, and driver provenance.

complexity.gate_count: Not applicable: this dense reference does not synthesize a circuit
complexity.error_scaling: For a fixed linear schedule, midpoint piecewise-constant integration converges as the schedule interval decreases; physical adiabatic error also depends on the spectral gap and total evolution time.
